headline: Glass vs Quirk Highlights Week 3 Showdown
subhead: Michigan State travels to Alabama with both teams searching for their first conference win.

xFactor.why: Arnold Glass leads the PCFL with 532 passing yards and five touchdowns through two weeks.

keyMatchup: Glass's top-ranked passing attack tests an Alabama secondary anchored by ballhawk Marv Quirk and his early interception.
body: Michigan State arrives at 0-2 but boasts the conference's fifth-ranked offense at 330 yards per game, fueled by Glass's 242.5 passing yards per contest and a scoring average of 25 points despite the winless start. The Spartans' defense has yielded 446.5 yards and 30 points per game, ranking 15th in the league, and will face an Alabama unit averaging 346.5 total yards with a 260.5-yard passing attack that ranks 13th overall.

Alabama enters 1-1 after a one-point road win over Boston College, yet its defense sits 18th in the PCFL allowing 502 yards and 27.5 points per game. The Crimson Tide's pass rush will rely on containing Glass without a proven sack leader, while Quirk's lone interception represents the secondary's best hope to disrupt a Michigan State aerial attack that has already produced five touchdown strikes.
